items.title: Gamepad support in matches
items.body: Play with a controller: the left stick pans the camera, the right stick moves the cursor, A selects, X or RT gives orders, B stops, Y finds idle villagers.

items.title: Custom game rules
items.body: Skirmish setup now has a population limit and switches for the Wonder, Sacred Site and Relic victories.

items.title: Observer mode
items.body: After a defeat or in a replay, press Tab to follow each player and see their age, population and resources.

items.title: Audio mixer
items.body: Voices, interface sounds and ambience now have their own volume sliders next to Master, Music and Effects.
